scope: USYC performance-fee component only; not total subscription/services or net profit
method: Known Q4 fee observations plus an explicit remaining-period projection; second case fixes NAV at latest reported value and gross yield at trailing observed rate.
limitations: Historical source is a current issuer API snapshot, not archived intraday vintage
Price-report dates may differ from economic accrual and company revenue-recognition timing
Future NAV, yields, fee terms and redemptions can change
Not a forecast for undisclosed integration, maintenance or license contracts
Does not revise the earlier total other-revenue forecast or the separate ARC scenario
